generic_cli_fractional_default.scope: reusable CNN CLI utility, not the historical pre-generated train/val/test data contract

current_experiment_reference.note: This is the current four-way experiment contract after Calibration was separated; it must not be misreported as the historical three-way preprocessing split.

decision_semantics.ADMITTED: Meets every frozen admit threshold and has no structural rejection reason.
decision_semantics.HOLD: Structurally usable but below one or more admit thresholds without crossing a frozen reject floor, or policy is still draft.
decision_semantics.REJECT: Structurally unusable or crosses at least one frozen reject floor.

notes: Do not replace missing historical minimum-row evidence with arbitrary round numbers. No explicit fixed minimum N per split has been found in the versioned historical preprocessing notebook, PPT, README, or recovered exclusion table.
The historical implemented eligibility rule was relational: all three splits present, no >1h continuity gap, and validation/test counts must not exceed train count.
The old generic 60/20/20 CLI default is not the same thing as the historical calendar-based train/validation/test preprocessing contract.
The current experiment is 60/15/10/15 because Calibration is separate; preserve that distinction when comparing old and current results.
A calendar year is evidence, not a permanent admission rule. fixed_start_year must stay null/false unless a future canonical data contract explicitly requires one.
Final training selection must preserve a common temporal split and must not choose per-plant test windows after looking at performance.
